answer.rationale: The latency increase followed a release and memory_b1 shows rollback clearing a checkout error spike without customer impact. Peak heavy writes also make capacity pressure plausible, so memory_b3 is worth verifying. Regional failover is unsafe because writes are hot and has previously caused a replication gap and lost writes; read routing and circuit breaking do not directly address the write path. Use a guarded rollback first to limit blast radius while preserving customer writes.
